column_description: A BIGSERIAL primary key uniquely identifying a device (e.g., 501).
An enum (devicetype_enum) describing device OS type (iOS, Windows, MacOS, Android).
An enum (browsertype_enum) referencing the browser used (Safari, Edge, Chrome, Firefox).
A VARCHAR(40) capturing the specific OS version (e.g., 'Windows10.0.19042').
A VARCHAR(20) for the app version if used (e.g., 'v3.1.2').
A VARCHAR(15) describing the viewport size in the browser/app (e.g., '414x896').
An enum (connectiontype_enum) for the network type (Cable, 5G, 4G, WiFi).
A NUMERIC(6,2) measuring network speed in Mbps (e.g., 25.75).
A BIGINT FK linking to Users(UserKey) to show which user owns or uses this device.
